instruction: I want to clear my browsing history to remove all records of visiting Amazon. Please help me delete all Amazon-related history entries from my browser to maintain my privacy.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to clear browsing history (instead of cookies) for Amazon. Uses existing getter 'get_history' and metric 'check_history_deleted' with keyword-based checking. The evaluator verifies that no URLs containing 'amazon.com' remain in the browser history after the task is completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to delete Amazon-related browsing history
Getter 'get_history' properly extracts browsing history data from Chrome's History database
Metric 'check_history_deleted' correctly checks for absence of keyword 'amazon.com' in history URLs
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure the History database file can be accessed (Chrome locks it while running)
Expected value 'amazon.com' is semantically correct for detecting Amazon-related history entries
Data flow is correct: history_data (list of tuples) -> metric extracts URLs (tuple[0]) -> searches for keywords -> returns 1.0 if deleted, 0.0 if present
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all aspects of the instruction (removal of Amazon URLs from history)
Return value semantics are correct: 1.0 indicates success (history deleted), 0.0 indicates failure (history still present)
